    ) AS u0 ON a.\"SellerId\" = u0.\"Id\"
    WHERE a.\"Id\" = @__id_0
    LIMIT 1
) AS s
LEFT JOIN \"Files\" AS f ON s.\"Id\" = f.\"AuctionItemId\"
ORDER BY s.\"Id\", s.\"Id0\""
